issuing_body: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) (国家药监局)
covered_actors: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and its affiliated units (国家药监局及相关单位)
Provincial-level drug regulatory bureaus (各省级局)
Drug regulatory departments at all levels (各级药品监管部门)
Pharmaceutical and medical device industry (医药产业, including producers of high-risk products such as blood products and traditional Chinese medicine injections)
enforcement_authorities: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) (国家药监局)
Provincial-level drug regulatory bureaus (各省级局)
Drug regulatory departments at all levels (各级药品监管部门)
compliance_deadlines: 2030: Preliminarily establish an integrated AI and drug regulation innovation system, operation and management mechanisms, high-quality datasets, vertical large models, and AI agents across review/approval, inspection, testing/monitoring, and government services
2035: Basically form a smart drug safety governance pattern that is digitally driven, intelligent, agile, autonomous and controllable, and ecosystem-collaborative
implementation_notes: Official policy interpretation (政策解读) of the NMPA Implementation Opinion on 'AI + Drug Regulation' (《国家药监局关于“人工智能+药品监管”的实施意见》). It outlines a 5-to-10-year strategic blueprint with 2030 and 2035 milestones covering seven smart regulatory application directions and five foundational support pillars (high-quality datasets, model/algorithm platforms, computing power infrastructure, security/risk assessment and transparency/validation norms, and governance/algorithm filing mechanisms). It explicitly defines AI as having an auxiliary role (辅助型定位) in drug regulation and does not impose direct statutory obligations or penalties on private entities.
